lines.trans: Teacher Song, tell me more about those two brothers on Wutong Lane!
The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.
And what about the younger brother holding the wooden train?
So quiet! He sat on the third step, listening to every single note.
Listening to the sound inside the room... wait a second!
Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.
Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...
Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!
Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!
Teacher Song?! The Teacher Song who taught my brother piano every Friday?!
Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...
Yes, Qing. That blue suitcase is mine—and I will tell you both the whole truth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià yǔ. Literally 'fall rain'; Mandarin expresses weather with verb + weather noun.

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gèng. Placed before an adjective or mental verb to form a comparative ('even better' 更好).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn. Describes cozy warmth of tea, sunlight, or clothing.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 喝碗热汤，身子一下子就暖了。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup and you warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn wèi. Introduces a reason; often paired with 所以 ('therefore') in the next clause.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī. Describes clothes, shoes, or streets wet from rain.

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi yè chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇百叶窗 ('a louvered shutter').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 午后把木百叶窗放下一半，屋里既凉快又柔和。
examples.trans: Lowering the wooden shutters halfway at noon keeps the room cool and soft.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu huà. Describes wooden beams or curtains softening echoes.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 厚实的棉窗帘柔化了早晨刺眼的阳光。
examples.trans: Thick cotton curtains softened the bright morning sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条石板路 ('a flagstone lane').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 梧桐巷的青石板路已经走过了几代街坊。
examples.trans: Generations of neighbors have walked along Wutong Lane's flagstone path.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuán. Used for sounds, messages, or traditions traveling from one place or person to another.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 院子里传来好听的琴声。
examples.trans: Lovely piano music drifted across the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí lái. Directional compound for returning toward the speaker's place.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵回声 ('an echo').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 空荡荡的大厅里能听见脚步的回声。
examples.trans: In the empty hall you can hear the echo of footsteps.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān sheng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位先生 ('a gentleman').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后面 ('the very back').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān na. Natural exclamation of surprise.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng. Counts naturally paired items: shoes, socks, chopsticks, hands (一双皮鞋 'a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jing. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双眼睛 ('a pair of eyes').

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

related.gloss: a pair of eyes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo. Read first tone jiāo when teaching a skill or person (教钢琴 'teach piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán qín. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Teacher Song?! The Teacher Song who taught my brother piano every Friday?!

examples.text: 每天下午她都在窗边安静地弹琴。
examples.trans: Every afternoon she plays the piano quietly by the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī yī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 上星期一 ('last Monday').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个晚上 ('an evening').

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
examples.trans: Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个箱子 ('a suitcase / box').

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng li xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个行李箱 ('a suitcase').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qíng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个实情 ('the real situation').

examples.text: 对，小晴。那个蓝行李箱是我的——我把实情全告诉你们。
examples.trans: Yes, Qing. That blue suitcase is mine—and I will tell you both the whole truth.

examples.text: 他决定把实情一五一十告诉大家。
examples.trans: He decided to tell everyone the plain truth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gào su. Takes a person directly followed by the information (告诉我 'tell me').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià cì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 下一次 ('the next occasion').

examples.text: 下次来成都，一定再来住我们客栈！
examples.trans: Next time you come to Chengdu, be sure to stay at our inn again!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，我们下次见！
examples.trans: It was lovely chatting today—see you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!
